title: Bird Day Afternoon
subtitle: The Feathered City Bus Hijack
description: Assume the role of charismatic, driving-obsessed birds. Declare love, steal hot dogs, drive a speeding city bus with Keanu Reeves, and insult the mayor.

characters.name: Mallard
characters.description: The iconic duck — charismatic, adaptable, and found worldwide. A green head, yellow bill, and some very regular-looking feathers.

characters.name: Ostrich
characters.description: Really too big to be a bird, but it has feathers and lays eggs, so there you have it. Fast, bad-tempered, and as dumb as they look.

characters.name: Eagle
characters.description: A powerful symbol of both freedom and bellicosity. Some species hunt prey up to 8 times their own body weight.

characters.name: Swan
characters.description: Basically just a surly goose who did a semester abroad in France and now thinks it's better than other comparably large waterfowl.

characters.name: Platypus
characters.description: Not technically a bird, but a marsupial. Cannot fly. Does not have feathers. Included here by popular demand.

characters.name: Flamingo
characters.description: With pink plumage and an easygoing littoral lifestyle, the FLAMINGO is a symbol of just letting the vibes be, man.

characters.name: Seagull
characters.description: Known for being loud, rowdy, and stealing things from little kids who were just having a nice day at the beach.

challenges.prompt: It is a truth universally acknowledged that a single bird in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a lady bird. You see a beautiful lady duck one sunny morning. HOW DO YOU DECLARE YOUR LOVE?
challenges.goal: Make the lady duck fall in love with you.

challenges.prompt: Now no longer interested in romance, but instead hungry, you see a 5-year-old eating a hotdog at a park bench. HOW DO YOU GET THAT HOT DOG?
Fed and romantically satisfied, you turn toward the problems of an unjust society. You see a statue of a colonizin' sonofagun. HOW DO YOU SHOW YOUR DISRESPECT?
As a crowd cheers, you see the #14 bus stopping nearby. You've always dreamed of driving a city bus. HOW DO YOU CONVINCE THE DRIVER TO LET YOU DRIVE?
challenges.goal: Convince the driver to let you drive the bus.

challenges.prompt: Bird at the wheel! A passenger requests the next stop. HOW DO YOU BRING THE BUS SAFELY TO A HALT?
Actor Keanu Reeves gets on! The radio crackles. HOW DO YOU CONVINCE THE PERSON ON THE OTHER END THAT YOU ARE THE BUS DRIVER AND NOT A BIRD?
challenges.goal: Convince the radio operator you're the bus driver.

challenges.prompt: The radio says if the bus goes below 55 mph it will explode! Keanu thinks he should drive. HOW DO YOU CONVINCE KEANU TO LET YOU KEEP DRIVING?
challenges.goal: Convince Keanu to let you drive the bus.

challenges.prompt: The highway ramp ahead is unfinished. You'll have to jump the gap! HOW DO YOU MAKE SURE THE BUS CLEARS IT?
You clear the jump, but passengers are freaking out. HOW DO YOU CALM THEM DOWN?
You need to get passengers off the bus. You see a passing flock of geese! HOW DO YOU ATTRACT THEIR ATTENTION AND GET THEIR HELP?
challenges.goal: Get the help of the passing flock of geese.

challenges.prompt: The geese lift each passenger to safety. Now it's just you and Keanu. HOW DO YOU BOTH ESCAPE THE EXPLODING BUS?
challenges.goal: Escape the bus before it explodes.

challenges.prompt: Keanu is super grateful and giving you romance eyes. HOW DO YOU LET HIM KNOW YOU STILL LOVE THE LADY DUCK?
challenges.goal: Make Keanu feel okay about the lady duck.

challenges.prompt: The mayor wants to give you a medal, but you recognize it's a photo op and there's a recent corruption scandal. HOW DO YOU SHOW YOU DON'T NEED HIS TRINKETS?
It's just you and the lady duck now. HOW DO YOU SPEND THE REST OF YOUR BEAUTIFUL LIVES TOGETHER?
